name: Wow Jobs
notes: Calls itself Canada's largest job search engine (the site's own claim as relayed by the directory). Listed by Job Junction, a third-party directory. Headquarters, ownership and API details are not stated and not yet checked.

review.note: wowjobs.ca returns a 301 to simplyhired.ca. The redirect target is off-domain and was not followed. The headless reader hit a Cloudflare challenge on the target, so no own-domain page with ownership text was read.

sources.title: Job Junction: national job boards (third-party directory)
